stories.title: Buzz from 12 NFL training camps -- including the latest on Daniel Jones, Patrick Mahomes, Travis Hunter
stories.summary: Here's what we heard on the road at training camp for the Bears, Bucs, Chargers, Chiefs, Colts, Commanders, Dolphins, Jaguars, Falcons, Packers, Rams and Vikings.

stories.title: Browns QB1? Giants WR reps? One important training camp battle for each team
stories.summary: We picked the top position battles to keep an eye on as training camp and the preseason roll on.

stories.title: Sources: Falcons RB Robinson gets record deal
stories.summary: Bijan Robinson and the Atlanta Falcons reached agreement on a three-year extension worth up to $75 million that will make him the highest-paid running back in NFL history, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Flowers, Ravens reach 4-year, $140M extension
stories.summary: Two-time Pro Bowl receiver Zay Flowers has agreed with the Ravens on a four-year, $140M extension that includes $108 million guaranteed, his agency told ESPN.

stories.title: Buckeyes, Ducks lead off preseason coaches' poll
stories.summary: Ohio State starts the 2026 season as the No. 1 team in the AFCA Coaches Poll as the Big Ten tries to extend its run of college football national champions to four.
